Absent.meaning: unique manifest section is absent from a structurally valid ELF

Malformed.meaning: ELF metadata or manifest uniqueness, bytes, length, version, flags, class, or reserved data is invalid

ValidV1.meaning: exact 8-byte v1 record upcast to in-memory v2 with legacy protection class

ValidV2.meaning: exact 16-byte v2 record satisfying class, flag, and reserved-zero rules
